## Prompt

> Create polished original key art for Project Sottovoce, showing the fictional Renaissance-Italian glassmakers' quarter of Vessalia as a dense crowd becomes a tense deduction puzzle. The image itself must contain no words or logo.
>
> Narrow stone streets, arcades, balconies, bridges and glass furnaces at blue hour; warm furnace light glows from interiors while exterior streets remain cool and desaturated. Show many civilians with repeated identical figures from four clearly different silhouette families: a low broad glasswright with apron and goggles on the brow; a floor-triangle street singer with bell skirt and tall coiled headdress; a tall thin lamp-tender in a hooded cloak carrying a long plain wick-pole that breaks the head line; and a rounded weighmaster carrying a ledger box. Copies within each family must look identical. No single figure is visibly marked as the player.
>
> Use a premium cinematic digital-painting style with restrained realism, readable silhouettes, atmospheric depth and quiet observational tension. Frame a wide 16:9 street-level scene with layered crowd depth. Use desaturated plaster, stone, terracotta, weathered timber and dull brass, with controlled amber, rose, cyan and jade clothing accents.
>
> Keep the design entirely original and period-plausible. No text, logo, interface, markers, minimap, weapons, blood, violence, modern objects, singular heroic protagonist, commercial-game iconography, grid-white glitch treatment, or per-instance costume variation inside a silhouette family.

## Review notes

The image uses historical architecture and functional silhouette cues from the project's art bible. It contains no imported source image, brand mark, named character, user-interface treatment, or game asset. The generated file remains repository documentation and is not referenced by any Godot scene or export resource.
